name: TOTAL
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 cells written from TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib, statement of profit or loss), Group six months (year to date) 30 June 2026 column, printed in N'000 and stored as absolute naira. CORRECTION: the H1 2026 Operating Profit (EBIT) cell held 4,950,597,000, which is this period profit after taxation and not the operating profit; the printed operating profit is 14,522,376. Operating expenses is the sum of the printed operating expense lines 5,001,190, 41,274,141, 32,828 and 16,334. Ties exactly: gross profit 56,499,284 plus other income 4,347,585 less 46,324,493 equals operating profit 14,522,376; 14,522,376 less net finance costs 7,813,630 equals profit before income taxation 6,708,746; 6,708,746 less income tax 1,758,149 equals profit after taxation 4,950,597. | FILL 20261007 second pass: CORRECTION to the same H1 2026 column. The Cost of Sales cell held 439,040,104,000 and the Gross Profit cell held 4,950,597,000, which is this period profit after taxation and not a gross profit. The printed statement figures replace them: revenue 443,990,701 less cost of sales 387,491,417 equals gross profit 56,499,284.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47674_TOTALENERGIES_MARKETING_NIGERIA_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them.
